verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has strong, well-documented glTF import support (dedicated importer docs, sandbox/model viewer, and general multi-format support including .babylon/glTF/STL/OBJ), and community feedback praises smooth import of 3D model data. However, there is no evidence in the pack of native FBX or USD import support, which are explicitly part of the story's required format set — missing for 10: FBX import documentation/tooling, USD import support, independent confirmation of clean FBX/USD round-tripping.
